title: What Are You Remaining In?
headline: What Are You Really Abiding In?
tagline: Freedom begins when agreement with lies ends and abiding in Christ begins.
seo_title: What Are You Abiding In? A Shame and Grace Audit (John 15:5) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Some remain in guilt, fear or yesterday's failures. A short audit for men from John 15:5 and Colossians 3:1-2 on shame, repentance and grace.
verse_text: I am the vine; you are the branches…. apart from Me you can do nothing.

scriptures.text: I am the vine; you are the branches…. apart from Me you can do nothing.
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

blocks.text: John 15 quietly asks every believer one question:

items: Most people immediately answer, “Jesus.”
But if we’re honest, our thoughts, emotions and reactions often reveal something different.
Some remain in guilt.
Some remain in fear.
Some remain in comparison.
Some remain in yesterday’s failures.
Some remain in shame.
Whatever your heart repeatedly returns to….
will eventually shape what grows from your life.
Freedom isn’t found by remaining in your failure.
Freedom grows by remaining in Christ.
Attention is never neutral.
What occupies your mind influences your heart.
What shapes your heart shapes your character.
And what shapes your character shapes your life.
Do I carry shame?
Do I hide when I fail?
Do I truly believe God’s grace is enough for me?
Do I practice repentance quickly?
Do I walk in the freedom Christ purchased for me?
What accusation have I been agreeing with?
What truth from God’s Word exposes that accusation as a lie?
Conviction agrees with God’s truth.
Condemnation agrees with the enemy’s accusations.
Your life is usually moving toward whatever consistently captures your attention.
Freedom begins when agreement with lies ends…. and abiding in Christ begins.
